title: quant-kernel: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant-fusion performance path
author: Ethan Chen
description: Optimize quantized inference kernels and runtime glue to improve throughput and latency for INT8/FP8 models. This change implements a fused dequantization path for SmoothQuant-prepared weights, extends the kernel selection logic to prefer INT8 microkernels when sequence length and kv cache hit rates make it beneficial, and adds a small scheduler tweak to prioritize continuous-batching groups with compatible shapes. Motivation: production workloads show 15-40% token throughput improvements with quantized kernels but regress on some long-sequence KV-cache-heavy patterns. This PR aims to keep gains intact while avoiding regressions on cache-heavy streaming workloads. Checklist: - [x] Implement fused dequant + matmul microkernel for SmoothQuant weights - [x] Extend kernel selector heuristics (sequence length distribution, kv_cache_hit_ratio) - [x] Add unit + integration tests for dequant fusion and kv-cache scenarios - [x] Add perf benchmark harness entry and compare against previous kernel - [x] Update release notes and docs for quantization profiles Notes: The description includes implementation details (see commits) and links to related Linear tickets ENG-1423 and ENG-1987 for perf targets and rollout plan. CI initially failed on a flaky vectorized test and was rerun after a small test harness timeout increase. No public API changes.
